option_relations.rationale: Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa (DEB) is a broader category that includes Recessive Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa (RDEB) with revertant mosaicism.
Recessive Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa (RDEB) is a broader category that includes RDEB with revertant mosaicism.
Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa with Revertant Mosaicism is a broader category that includes the specific type of RDEB with revertant mosaicism described in the leaf.

The option 'Severe generalized recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (RDEB) with revertant mosaicism' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'Recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (RDEB) with revertant mosaicism presenting as chronic non-healing ulcer', as the vignette describes a severe, generalized presentation (large unhealed ulcer) and the genetic findings support RDEB with revertant mosaicism.
